boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along South Main, Main, Seneca, Castle, Exchange, South Exchange, and Lakefront streets in Geneva’s practical campus orbit.

cards.title: Trace Geneva Through Changing Exhibits
cards.subtitle: South Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk north on South Main Street to explore community history exhibits inside the historic Prouty-Chew House; confirm seasonal hours first.
cards.short_summary: A historic house introduces the people and places that shaped Geneva.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Geneva states that the museum occupies the Prouty-Chew House at 543 South Main Street and presents long-term and changing community-history exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Public museum with seasonal hours; archival research appointments are available Tuesday through Friday. Admission is a suggested $5 donation.

cards.title: Browse Books and Community Programs
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue toward Main Street for collections, technology help, local-history resources, and public programs; check the calendar before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: The city library combines borrowing, research resources, events, and practical services.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official site lists its location at 244 Main Street and offers collections, adult and youth programs, technology help, genealogy resources, and room reservations.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Monday–Friday and Saturday; the official site advises checking holiday and closing information.

cards.title: See a Film or Live Performance
cards.subtitle: Seneca Street corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto Seneca Street for the restored downtown theater; consult the event calendar and use the official ticket source for the selected program.
cards.short_summary: Geneva’s historic theater presents films, concerts, plays, and other performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smith identifies its venue at 82 Seneca Street, while HWS documents it as a downtown theater hosting films, concerts, plays, and performances.
cards.source_title: FAQs – Smith Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on the scheduled event and ticket terms. Backpacks, outside food, weapons, alcohol, and open containers are prohibited.

cards.title: Browse New and Vintage Books
cards.subtitle: Seneca Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 41 Seneca Street to browse new and vintage books, cards, gifts, and framed prints; review seasonal hours before making the walk downtown.
cards.short_summary: An independent storefront pairs books with prints, cards, gifts, and custom framing.
cards.evidence_claim: Stomping Grounds’ official site documents its new and vintage book collection, gifts, cards, and custom framing; Geneva Concerts identifies the store at 41 Seneca Street.
cards.access_notes: Retail storefront with seasonal hours posted on its official site; purchases and custom-framing services are optional.

cards.title: Explore Model Trains, Kites, and Chess Sets
cards.subtitle: Exchange Street corridor at Castle Street
cards.notes: Cross to the Castle and Exchange corner to inspect model trains, rockets, chess sets, kites, and radio-controlled vehicles before choosing a project.
cards.short_summary: A downtown hobby shop covers tabletop, model-building, outdoor, and radio-controlled interests.
cards.evidence_claim: The business’s official site places Lake City Hobbies at the corner of Castle and Exchange streets and lists chess sets, kites, rockets, model trains, and radio-controlled vehicles.
cards.access_notes: Public retail shop; contact the business to confirm current opening hours or product availability.

cards.title: Arrange a Bike Rental or Repair
cards.subtitle: Exchange Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow Exchange Street to ask about bicycle rentals, repairs, or equipment; contact the shop beforehand to confirm the service and bike availability.
cards.short_summary: A downtown bicycle shop supports rentals, maintenance, and equipment needs.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS identifies Geneva Bicycle Center at 489 Exchange Street and states that it provides bicycle sales, rentals, and repairs.
cards.source_title: Geneva Partnership | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Retail and service business; rental, repair, and merchandise availability should be confirmed directly before visiting.

cards.title: Take a Coffee Break Downtown
cards.subtitle: Exchange Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause at 486 Exchange Street for coffee while exploring downtown; verify the day’s hours and menu directly before setting out from campus.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown coffee stop anchors a straightforward Exchange Street break.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists Working Class Coffee under its Geneva coffee recommendations and provides the address 486 Exchange Street.
cards.source_title: Places to Stay and Eat | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Public coffee shop recommended on the HWS visitor page; confirm current hours and menu with the business.

cards.title: Refuel on Castle Street
cards.subtitle: Castle Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to 68 Castle Street for a coffee stop between downtown errands; check current hours and offerings directly before beginning the walk.
cards.short_summary: A Castle Street coffee shop offers a defined pause in the downtown circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists Grounded Coffee Shop in its Geneva coffee section and gives its address as 68 Castle Street.
cards.source_title: Places to Stay and Eat | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Public coffee shop recommended on the HWS visitor page; contact the business for current hours and menu details.

cards.title: Plan an Off-Campus Breakfast
cards.subtitle: South Exchange Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk down South Exchange Street for breakfast at the café; call ahead to confirm current hours, seating, and menu before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A clearly identified South Exchange Street café provides a nearby breakfast destination.
cards.evidence_claim: HWS lists Water St. Café as a Geneva breakfast option at 467 South Exchange Street.
cards.source_title: Places to Stay and Eat | Hobart and William Smith Colleges
cards.access_notes: Public café identified by HWS as a breakfast option; call the listed business number to verify current service hours.

cards.title: Orient Yourself at the Lakefront
cards.subtitle: Lakefront Drive corridor
cards.notes: Finish at 35 Lakefront Drive to use visitor kiosks, indoor seating, Wi-Fi, restrooms, and the lakeside patio while planning another outing.
cards.short_summary: The lakefront visitor center combines regional information with practical public amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Finger Lakes Tourism Alliance places the Welcome Center at 35 Lake Front Drive and documents interactive kiosks, restrooms, Wi-Fi, seating, a patio, and a playground.
cards.source_title: Finger Lakes Welcome Center | Finger Lakes Tourism Alliance
cards.access_notes: Public visitor center with restrooms, indoor and patio seating, Wi-Fi, kiosks, and a playground; market purchases are optional.
